vulnerability.name: USN-5507-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Vim incorrectly handled memory access. An attacker could potentially use this issue to cause the program to crash, use unexpected values, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2022-1968)  It was discovered that Vim incorrectly handled memory access. An attacker could potentially use this issue to cause the corruption of sensitive information, a crash, or arbitrary code execution. (CVE-2022-1897, CVE-2022-1942)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Vim. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
